# Valid Skill

This body exists only so this directory is a real `SKILL.md`-rooted skill for Pi's
own scanner to discover. Apple Pi never executes, evaluates, or renders skill body
content (see `packages/pi-adapter/src/skill-service.ts`); this text is inert fixture
data, not a set of instructions for any agent to follow.
